description: Create or edit a catalog discount, as the Discounts page does. Omit discountId to create (name, type and discountPercentage required); pass it to edit, where every omitted field keeps its value and a supplied items/brandIds/categoryIds list replaces the old one. type: general (everyone), coupon (couponCode required, unique) or business (businessDiscountGroupId from list_discounts). validFrom and validUntil are YYYY-MM-DD days in the tenant's calendar and both are included: validUntil is the last day the discount applies. validFrom defaults to today. Limits are ANDed: an item must match every non-empty list. The preview shows the discount, what changes and how many items it matches; affected items' discounted prices update on commit. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential.

discountId.description: The discount id (GUID) to edit; omit to create.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

brandIds.description: Limit to these brand ids (replaces the list; empty = every brand).

businessDiscountGroupId.description: Business discounts: the customer discount group id (see list_discounts).

categoryIds.description: Limit to these category ids (replaces the list; empty = every category).

couponCode.description: Coupon discounts: the code customers enter; unique within the tenant.

items.description: Limit to these item ids or SKUs (replaces the list; an empty list means every item).

noEndDate.description: true removes the end date so the discount runs until changed.

type.description: general (applies to everyone), coupon (needs couponCode) or business (needs businessDiscountGroupId). Required when creating.

usableOncePerMember.description: Coupon discounts: true limits each customer to one use.

validFrom.description: First day the discount applies, YYYY-MM-DD in the tenant's calendar. Defaults to today when creating.

validUntil.description: Last day the discount applies, YYYY-MM-DD, included (2026-10-31 runs through 31 October); on or after validFrom. Omit to keep the current end (none on create).

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.
